episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: The new pastor arrives in Kengis. A shepherd girl goes missing and the Pastor initiates a search.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The Pastor suspects that Hilda has been murdered. Jussi attends a local dance and disaster strikes.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Jolina is found beaten. She was attacked by a man, not a bear. There is a killer on the loose.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jolina is dead - the killer has struck again. Jussi leaves Kengis to find his family.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The Pastor and Jussi are reunited, and a new murder shocks the village.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jussi is arrested, and the murderer's identity is revealed, leading to a devastating showdown.
